title: Augur 1.3 additions read by the Sprites observation contract (proposal; docs/OBSERVATION_CONTRACT.md)
description: Only the keys a 1.3 producer ADDS: top-level `coverage` and `foreign[]`. Everything else is augur/schema/snapshot.schema.json, which a fixture must also pass. Not yet adopted by Augur: plan step 4 (D) lands it there. A 1.2 producer publishes neither key, and a reader then treats no foreign scope as covered.

coverage.description: one stamp per foreign collector. `unknown` (a reason) = the collector failed and NO scopes key is present; otherwise `scopes` maps each scope the collector looked at (a tmux socket, a docker socket, a model server, or `*`) to its status. Only `complete` in a fresh stamp lets a reader remove an object of that scope.

id.description: execution identity: a declared run id (fresh per execution, never the session name), `mux:<socket>:<pane>:<pid>@<start>`, `ctr:<immutable container id>`, `model:<server>:<name>`

collector.description: the coverage entry that may remove it

kind.description: remote_job | container | resident_model | unknown; a reader maps any other value to unknown, never to the nearest kind

label.description: declared items only; never a session name or command line (Augur rule 3)

launched_from.description: Waypoint machine key of the launching host (ruling 7)

attach.description: declared remote_job only: an attach-only target bound to this execution

terminal.description: written by the execution host when the run ends, and kept (not deleted). Absence of an item is never an exit status.
